g.text: Identical basal delivery and native plasma/action/glucose equilibrium across arms; each absorption system has its own steady depots.
Pulse: 2 U delivered over minutes 120–125 (shaded). Meal: 40 g over minutes 120–135 (bottom bar). Standard 0.25 min maximum integration interval.
The experimental arm replaces absorption only; native clearance and glucose equations remain. These synthetic differences do not establish clinical accuracy.
